prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim you have on file. Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, in person, by telephone, or in writing.

Please provide, within ten days of receipt, a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the incident, along with the stated bodily injury and property damage liability limits and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this loss. This includes claim files, adjuster notes, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, surveillance or parking lot video, repair estimates, and any communications with the other parties involved. Any deletion or alteration of such material could seriously prejudice our client's claim.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
